recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless future build tooling stops publishing images/mapping.g4 to mapping.g4.
issue_request: FHIR-17191 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction reporting that http://hl7.org/fhir/2018Jan/mapping.g4 was broken from the FHIR mapping-language page and requesting a fix.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in svn revision 14431, preserved as git commit 83a6890014a2d1cc1811f8e66c2a0ba9efe7773b, which removed the introductory mapping.g4 link from source/mapping-language.html. The grammar and publish mapping had been added earlier in fffa6cd98dda7c737733f0fb352a4c69c790053e, and later commit 7b1914afeb19a274f6a9806ebb3a214165189356 pointed the formal grammar section at mapping.g4.
additional_context: Current source keeps the formal grammar link to mapping.g4, publish.ini includes mapping.g4 in the [images] section, and images/mapping.g4 exists. The current CI build serves mapping.g4 and renders the mapping-language formal grammar link. Zulip discussion records the original 2018Jan 404 report and older mapping-language discussion references the grammar source under build/images/mapping.g4; Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/build relationship already resolves the original broken-link request: the grammar file is build-scoped through publish.ini and the linked output path is reachable.
